# Supadomain

> Supadomain is a self-hosted domain expiration checker and domain expiry monitor built with Nuxt, Vue and MongoDB. It looks up domain expiration dates over RDAP (through rdap.org) when a domain is added or refreshed, compares the stored dates with alert thresholds every hour, then sends Slack webhook alerts before domains expire. It does not fall back to WHOIS.

Run it from a clone: `npm install`, copy `.env.example` to `.env`, set `MONGODB_URI`, `NUXT_SESSION_PASSWORD`, `ADMIN_EMAIL` and `ADMIN_PASSWORD`, then `npm run build` and `node --env-file=.env .output/server/index.mjs`. The admin account is created only on the first start against an empty database.

## Docs

- [Website](https://projects.halit.org/supadomain/): project site with guides for installation, Slack alerts, RDAP and configuration
- [Domain expiry checker](https://projects.halit.org/supadomain/domain-expiry-checker/): in-browser RDAP lookup of a domain's expiry date, registrar and status
- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/supadomain/blog/): articles on domain renewal, expired domain transfers, RDAP errors and redaction, Slack webhooks
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/supadomain/blob/main/README.md): features, prerequisites, installation, environment variables, Slack notification setup and how RDAP lookups work
- [RDAP lookup](https://github.com/halitsever/supadomain/blob/main/server/rdap-query.ts): how expiry dates are fetched over RDAP
- [Hourly check](https://github.com/halitsever/supadomain/blob/main/server/plugins/cron.ts): the hourly job that reads RDAP again for domains checked more than a day ago, compares expiry dates with alert thresholds and sends Slack messages
- [Admin seeding](https://github.com/halitsever/supadomain/blob/main/server/plugins/database.ts): how the MongoDB connection is opened and the first admin user is created from the environment
- [Domain model](https://github.com/halitsever/supadomain/blob/main/server/models/domain.schema.ts): stored fields for each monitored domain, including notification thresholds
